description: Active Directory lab on net151: one Windows Server 2025 domain controller (ad-dc01, VMID 1201, IP 192.168.151.201) for the domain range42.lab (NetBIOS RANGE42) with its DNS server, and one Windows 11 Enterprise client (ad-client01, VMID 1202, IP 192.168.151.202) joined to that domain. Both are cloned from the unattended Windows templates 9250 and 9251 (bundles/proxmox/template.build.windows) and reached over OpenSSH with a PowerShell shell.
